name: FL Studio MCP
tagline: Mix, route and compose inside FL Studio from plain-language requests
description: MCP server for FL Studio (Fruity Loops) 2025 and 2026. Mix Doctor scans the whole mix and proposes fixes, plus gain staging, calibrated EQ, compression, reverb and delay, plugin parameters in real units, routing, playlist, patterns, and writing melodies, chords and drum steps. Every change can be undone. 90 tools. Setup is one command on macOS; Windows needs loopMIDI.

env.name: FLSTUDIO_MCP_TRANSPORT
env.description: Not needed. Older setups set it to tcp to reach the fl-studio-mcp-daemon bridge; that still works.
